_what: Stage 00b intake gate (PIPELINE_V2.md s3). Every panel or table that supplies a value, with the tier it came from. Written BEFORE any extraction code was authored for this folder.

paper.title: Optimization of Lipid Nanoparticle Formulations for mRNA Delivery in vivo with Fractional Factorial and Definitive Screening Designs
paper.experiment_ID_basis: FIRST AUTHOR initials + year (Kauffman K J, 2015). The folder name andersondg_26469188 names the PI, which is not the corpus key.

held_files.belongs_to_this_paper_because: three independent attestations, not a file count: (a) the filename stem nl5b02497 is the DOI suffix 10.1021/acs.nanolett.5b02497; (b) SI page 1 reproduces the Europe PMC title and the full 8-author list in order, including affiliations; (c) every one of the 14 pages carries the publisher watermark path pubs.acs.org/nalefd/article-supplement/1257894/pdf/nl5b02497_si_001/.
held_files.zip_byte_identity_check: NOT AVAILABLE. Europe PMC reports inPMC=N, isOpenAccess=N, hasSuppl=N and pmcid=null, so there is no Europe PMC supplementaryFiles ZIP to diff this file against. The three attestations above stand in its place.
held_files.f065_contamination_guard: No file was copied into source/ by this curation. The folder held exactly one file on arrival and holds exactly one file now; its name and sha256 are pinned above and re-asserted in 07_qc.json. No glob copy out of the shared session scratchpad was performed at any point.

main_text_not_held.status: The main article (Nano Lett 15:7300-7306) is NOT held and was NOT fetched.
main_text_not_held.why: Closed access: Europe PMC fullTextUrlList offers only availabilityCode=S ('Subscription required') via DOI. isOpenAccess=N, inPMC=N, authMan=N, epmcAuthMan=N, nihAuthMan=N -> there is no PMC author manuscript either. elink dbfrom=pubmed db=pmc returns ONLY pubmed_pmc_refs (citing articles) and NO pubmed_pmc self-link, so there is no deposit of any kind. No paywall or bot-check bypass was attempted.
main_text_not_held.consequence: Every value emitted here comes from the SI. Figures 1-4 of the main text are not read, and the main text's naming of the PEG-lipid is unavailable - see the PEG gap in 08_contradictions.csv and D-3.

value_sources.locus: SI Table S1, page 2: 'Parameters, characterization, and efficacy of Library A, B, and C LNP formulations used in this study.'
value_sources.supplies: Serum EPO (ng/mL, mean +/- SD, n=3) for 36 LNP formulations and 1 PBS control, plus each formulation's C12-200:mRNA weight ratio, phospholipid identity, and the four molar percentages (C12-200 / phospholipid / cholesterol / PEG), plus EE%, size (nm) and PDI.
value_sources.tier_sentence: pdfplumber extract_text() on page 2 returns all 41 data lines as native text characters - the page carries 2913 char objects and 0 image objects, so no pixel of this table is read by anything.
value_sources.tiers_1_to_3_why_not_needed: Not applicable: tier 4 succeeded completely. Tier 1 (publisher Source Data) does not exist for a 2015 ACS Nano Letters paper; tier 2 (a separate SI table file) does not exist - hasSuppl=N and the only supplementary artifact is this PDF; tier 3 (author repository) was searched and found nothing (see repo_search below).

value_sources.locus: SI page 10, the Definitive Screening Design table (unnumbered, inside 'Supplementary Methods: Detailed Description of Statistical Methodology')
value_sources.supplies: A SECOND, INDEPENDENT PARAMETERISATION of formulations A-01..A-14: the coded design string (6 characters of +/0/-), phospholipid head and tail as separate tokens, weight ratio, C12-200 mol%, phospholipid mol%, PEG mol%. Supplies no efficacy value.
value_sources.tier_sentence: Native text, 2363 char objects and 0 images on page 10; pdfplumber find_tables() reports a 16x8 table there.
value_sources.used_for: Row-wise cross-parameterisation check against Table S1, and the coded-level monotonicity check. NOT a value source.

value_sources.locus: SI page 11, the Fractional Factorial Design table (unnumbered)
value_sources.supplies: A SECOND, INDEPENDENT PARAMETERISATION of formulations B-15..B-32: coded design string (5 characters), phospholipid, weight ratio, C12-200 mol%, phospholipid mol%, PEG mol%. Supplies no efficacy value.
value_sources.tier_sentence: Native text, 2596 char objects and 0 images on page 11; find_tables() reports a 20x7 table there.
value_sources.used_for: Same two checks as VS-2. NOT a value source.

value_sources.locus: SI Table S2, page 3: regression statistics for the Library B Standard Least Squares model
value_sources.supplies: Printed statistics used as external checks on the Table S1 values: n=54, Mean=2961.6, R2=0.887, RMSE=922.2, and the parameter estimate Phospholipid[DOPE]=2307.1.
value_sources.tier_sentence: Native text, 1190 char objects and 0 images on page 3.
value_sources.used_for: Independent reproduction of the Library B mean and of the DOPE main effect from the 18 Library B values. NOT a value source.

value_sources.supplies: Total flux (p/s) x 1e9, mean +/- SD, n=3, 6 h after 15 ug total mRNA IV, for 2 formulations ('Original, Luc' and 'C-35, Luc').
value_sources.tier_sentence: Native text, 902 char objects and 0 images on page 4; find_tables() reports a 4x11 table.

value_sources.supplies: Serum Factor VII (% of PBS, mean +/- SD, n=3) 72 h after IV siRNA at 0.1 / 0.03 / 0.01 mg/kg, for 2 formulations plus PBS.

pixels.statement: ZERO values in this curation come from pixels. No page was rendered, no raster was sampled, no axis was calibrated, no bar top was detected. curation/lib's axis/bars/heatmap modules are therefore not imported, and error classes 20, 23, 27, 28, 32, 33, 35 and 43 cannot arise here. This is the tier-4 outcome PIPELINE_V2 s3 names as the best available for a 2015 paper with native text tables.

repo_search.code_search_for_pmid: GitHub code search for the literal "26469188" returned 20 hits, none of which is a repository belonging to this paper.
repo_search.verdict: NO author repository, Zenodo, Dryad, Figshare or OSF deposit exists for this paper. Expected for a 2015 ACS paper with no data-availability statement.
repo_search.search_machinery_positive_control: The repo sweep is not silently broken: among its hits it returned MaoResearchGroup/falcon-lnp-optimization, which is the real author repository of the Toh 2026 FALCON paper this project has already curated as WT_2026. A query that can surface a known-good LNP repository is a query that is running.

licence.section8_verdict: FAILS the CC0/CC-BY-compatible requirement in CLAUDE.md s8. Funders recorded by Europe PMC are Shire and Skoltech/MIT, with no NIH grant, which is consistent with there being no public-access deposit. If this paper is admitted, only derived numerical values could be redistributed, never the SI PDF, and s8 needs an explicit ruling. See D-4.
